approvers: My adviser or broker, my accountant, my family, and my key staff
reason: The terms on staff, the name and the site are better than most, and a free confidential first meeting costs me nothing. But they have never bought a business before, and this is my life's work, so I will not sell to a newcomer on promises alone.
objection: You have no track record and no earlier sellers I can call. A bank letter is one thing, but I want to know you will still be treating my people well in five years.
instead: Keep running the business while my broker runs a process and collects offers on nexxt-change, or sell to a known buyer with a track record. Failing that, I keep working past retirement age.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a previous seller or from a bank or adviser I know and trust, plus a bank letter checked by my own adviser for the full price.
